div.div:
Notes
*1 The three layers have distinct roles
AWS HealthOmics for long-term storage and ingest, Amazon S3 Tables for structured variant queries, FSx for ONTAP for the POSIX intermediate layer that many hosts touch at once. A managed object store does not replace the POSIX shared file layer.
*2 Whether to route through FSx for ONTAP follows workload shape
When any of: many hosts at once, POSIX-dependent tools, large-file random access. A serverless execution base does not change the judgement.
*3 FlexCache with a non-AWS ONTAP service as Origin is unverified
On-premises ONTAP <-> FSx for ONTAP is documented. Based on published case configurations, not reproduced in the author's environment.
